email.subject: Recap: Meridian card feed kickoff (12 Jan)
email.summary: Thanks all. We agreed phase one scope for the Meridian card feed: daily SFTP ingestion with masking and duplicate checks, matching to SkyLane trips, automatic expense lines with an unassigned queue, billed-amount handling, an operations view and a full audit trail. The pilot client goes live on March 1.
decisions: Phase one uses the SFTP file drop, not the real-time API.
Only the last four digits of the card number are stored.
The matching window is plus or minus two days around the trip.
